cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. What keeps the soup inside that upside-down bowl?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then turn the spoon over. Let's test which thing owns down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the spoon sets the direction. Point it into the sink before we try putting it down.
